import csv, math, statistics
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
p='logs/summary/kpi_forward.csv'
with open\(p, newline=''\) as f:
    rows=list\(csv.DictReader\(f\)\)
print\('rows',len\(rows\)\)
keys=Counter\(\(r['Setting'],r['Scenario'],r['Protocol']\) for r in rows\)
print\('duplicate_keys',sum\(v>1 for v in keys.values\(\)\)\)
for setting in sorted\({r['Setting'] for r in rows}\):
    sr=[r for r in rows if r['Setting']==setting]
    by=defaultdict\(dict\)
    for r in sr: by[r['Scenario']][r['Protocol']]=r
    missing=[]; gains=[]; delay_best=loss_best=jain_best=delay_with2=jain_with002=0
    examples=[]
    for s,d in by.items\(\):
        if set\(d\)!={'TcpSwift','TcpNewReno','TcpCubic','TcpBbr'}: missing.append\(s\)
        sw=d['TcpSwift']; bases=[d[x] for x in \('TcpNewReno','TcpCubic','TcpBbr'\)]
        st=float\(sw['Goodput_Mbps']\); bt=max\(float\(x['Goodput_Mbps']\) for x in bases\)
        gain=\(st/bt-1\)*100; gains.append\(gain\); examples.append\(\(gain,s,st,bt\)\)
        sd=float\(sw['Delay_ms']\); bestd=min\(float\(x['Delay_ms']\) for x in d.values\(\)\)
        delay_best += abs\(sd-bestd\)<1e-12; delay_with2 += sd <= bestd*1.02
        sl=float\(sw['Loss_pct']\); bestl=min\(float\(x['Loss_pct']\) for x in d.values\(\)\)
        loss_best += abs\(sl-bestl\)<1e-12
        sj=float\(sw['Jain']\); bestj=max\(float\(x['Jain']\) for x in d.values\(\)\)
        jain_best += abs\(sj-bestj\)<1e-12; jain_with002 += sj >= bestj-0.002
    print\(setting,'scenarios',len\(by\),'missing',missing\)
    print\('gain min/median/mean/max',*\(round\(x,3\) for x in \(min\(gains\),statistics.median\(gains\),statistics.mean\(gains\),max\(gains\)\)\)\)
    print\('delay_best/within2',delay_best,delay_with2,'loss_best',loss_best,'jain_best/within.002',jain_best,jain_with002\)
    print\('lowest gains',[\(s,round\(g,3\)\) for g,s,_,_ in sorted\(examples\)[:3]]\)
    print\('highest gains',[\(s,round\(g,3\)\) for g,s,_,_ in sorted\(examples\)[-3:]]\)
invalid=[]
for r in rows:
    vals={k:float\(r[k]\) for k in \('BottleneckMbps','BaseOwdMs','Goodput_Mbps','Delay_ms','Jitter_ms','Loss_pct','Jain'\)}
    why=[]
    if vals['Goodput_Mbps']<=0 or vals['Goodput_Mbps']>vals['BottleneckMbps']*1.001: why.append\('throughput'\)
    if vals['Delay_ms']<=0 or vals['Delay_ms']<vals['BaseOwdMs']*0.999: why.append\('delay'\)
    if not \(0<=vals['Loss_pct']<=100\): why.append\('loss'\)
    if not \(0<=vals['Jain']<=1\): why.append\('jain'\)
    if why: invalid.append\(\(r['Setting'],r['Scenario'],r['Protocol'],why\)\)
print\('basic_invalid',len\(invalid\),invalid[:10]\)
print\('seed_values',sorted\({r.get\('Seeds',''\) for r in []}\)\)
